slides.title: A request becomes a working environment
slides.footnote: Principal run: controlled semantics, real local fixture operations.
slides.notes:
The mixed request asks for photo browsing, ratings, selection, manual exposure and crop, and review of a short video with optional audio. It forbids source modification and publication. Actual browser controls operated against generated local fixtures. Six synthetic photographs, a sixteen-frame sequence and synthetic PCM tones define the demonstrated material; camera RAW development is outside scope.

slides.title: The membrane carries bounded evidence
slides.footnote: BSEP is evidence, not an ActionCommitPacket, truth or permission.
slides.notes:
BSEP means Bounded Semantic Evidence Packet. The native DTO is built from the actual orchestrator proposal, route context and structured rationale. It includes observed facts, missing evidence, uncertainty, risk boundaries, rejected routes, required conditions, selected vectors and guards. The domain role context also uses a smaller needs/source_write/publication/separate_save projection. This is not the entire native BSEP. Public offline validation checks the recorded native DTO and source binding without reconstructing live authority.

slides.title: Root reviews the route and each effect
slides.footnote: Route acceptance does not grant permission to later commands.
slides.notes:
The runtime normalizes bounded claims and assembles evidence, checks, policy, time and permission state for the public Root decision kernel. Route acceptance happens before architect consumption. For a consequential command the system constructs a fresh finite packet, binds the actual local Root result, installs its lifecycle in the persistent Host and dispatches through the Effect Firewall. Neither model output nor an old receipt is a reusable grant. The BSEP explicitly records the rule: Gemini proposes, Root disposes.

slides.title: The next step consumes the actual output
slides.footnote: Runtime materializes topology; the semantic proposal remains advisory.
slides.notes:
The advisory SemanticArchitectProposal contains the role responses. Runtime materialization creates two Work items. compile_contract executes the deterministic compiler; consume_contract receives the first item material through an explicit WorkOutputBindingV01. Actual output validators compare produced values with computation, and the session reads the consumed contract. Mixed media later adds a separate finite media-plan Work under the same task and Host. Runtime constructs topology; model output does not supply arbitrary executable edges.

slides.title: Commands have types, scope and currentness
slides.footnote: No LLM call, D/E pass or U2 revision per click or frame.
slides.notes:
The principal compiled contract has ten operations: CROP, EXPOSURE, NEXT, PAUSE, PLAY, PREVIOUS, RATE, REVIEW_MEDIA, SEEK and SELECT. OPEN, REQUEST_SAVE, SAVE and END are separately managed lifecycle/save operations. Commands are checked for exact fields, ranges, session identity and version. The explicit shell/file probe exercises the production pure validator with a continuation canary, not an end-to-end hostile Host. UI state is advisory and does not grant action authority.

slides.title: Privacy policy changes the actual transfer
slides.footnote: Metadata minimization; no image-content redaction or OS sandbox claim.
slides.notes:
The principal selected preview_without_metadata. Fresh RGB encoding strips metadata; checked PNG chunks and bounded schemas constrain what crosses services. The media-to-session projection contains png, sha256, asset and session; session-to-display contains png, sha256 and frame_ref. The preview_only neighbor additionally permits checked derived output metadata. Source paths, credentials and EXIF/GPS are not forwarded to display. This is metadata minimization, not pixel-content redaction or same-UID isolation.

slides.footnote: One 250-byte sidecar; exact approval; originals preserved.
slides.notes:

SAVE obtains a current native packet and executes exactly once. A changed candidate requires a new approval. The principal result is 250 bytes with SHA25620e01b3ebd6f813bccf2ce51d23c71406a0f2b2cd706ab8bda92e71bed28a915. This sidecar stores parameters and source hashes, not rewritten originals or an external publication.

slides.title: Memory carries meaning across sessions
slides.footnote: Historical EWS3 LocalDRS; fresh Root, Host, resources and save consent.
slides.notes:
The actual historical DRS sequence starts with a cold SEARCH returning no candidate. Root-reviewed semantic content is written through public LocalDRS interfaces. Warm SEARCH evaluates current eligibility, requires fresh Root-approved SUMMARY_ONLY descent and returns bounded role values to their normal validators. New Host/resources and separate save consent remain necessary. DRS is durable retained storage; no Host, action permission, launch token or URL is restored from it. This history is distinct from the principal browser run.
